title: RAD Handoff Manifest
description: Schema for handoff-manifest.json — the metadata file every adapter writes at the root of src/design-handoff/. Supports contract v3 (markdown-only prose) and v3.1 (DESIGN.md hybrid format — YAML frontmatter + prose). See artifacts/docs/handoff-contract.md §Handoff manifest and §Design context document.

contract_version.description: Pinned to the handoff-contract.md version this manifest targets. v3.1 adds DESIGN.md hybrid format (YAML frontmatter + prose sections) for design-context.md. v3 (markdown-only prose) remains accepted for backward compatibility during adapter migration.

source_tool.description: Which AI design tool (or 'manual') produced the underlying output.

tool_version.description: Tool version or ship date. Use 'unknown' if the tool does not expose a version.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the adapter completed normalization.

feature_name.description: Required when mode is 'new-feature' or 'regen'. Null otherwise.

repo_linked_at_generation.description: Did the source tool have repo context at generation time? Some adapters record this to feed the C2 gate or equivalent.

tokens_match_app_css.description: Null for initial builds (no app.css exists yet). Boolean for new-feature/regen modes.

design_md_version.description: The DESIGN.md spec version the adapter's YAML frontmatter targets. Current: '0.1.1' (alpha). The adapter emits design-context.md YAML per this version; /design verify runs npx @google/design.md@[version] lint against it.

tool_specific.description: Free-form adapter-scoped fields. The pipeline never reads this. Examples: claude_design_bundle_url, figma_node_ids, stitch_design_md_hash.

notes.description: Free-text notes from the adapter — human-readable context.
